scope: Existing management, version readers, public legal readers, acceptance gates and owner evidence history. Functional/data/UI audit; no legal text approval or legal opinion. Source-reviewed is not full runtime acceptance.

rolePolicy.owner: Manage drafts/publish/history and evidence only while active, verified and satisfying configured MFA.
rolePolicy.admin: Public legal reading/own required acknowledgement only; no owner evidence or management.
rolePolicy.organizationRoles: No independent global legal management/evidence entitlement.
rolePolicy.userGuestRestricted: Published current legal documents readable; acknowledgement requires active verified user; closed history and drafts denied.

verificationBoundaries: No real legal acceptance, draft discard or publication created in production.
No production fanout or APNs test sent.
No real registration per user-established boundary.
Mock UI persistence, isolated SDK/handlers, production readback and physical acceptance are separate.
